levels.name: Sharp
levels.tagline: searches five and owns the centre

help.goal: Line up four of your discs in a row — across, up, or diagonally — before the other player does.
steps: Wait until the top line says your turn.
Tap a column anywhere down its height to drop a disc into it.
The disc hovering above the board shows the column you are about to use.
Your disc falls to the lowest free hole in that column.
A full column cannot be tapped — pick another.
notes: 🔴 always drops first, 🟡 second. The strip under the board says who is who and whose turn it is.
The winning four flashes white when the game ends.
If every hole fills with nobody connecting four, it is a draw.
Play alone and a bot takes the other seat: Easy drops almost anywhere but never misses a win or a block, Normal looks three moves ahead, Sharp searches five.
